Best Pals by work skill

Every base job has its own ranking. Assign one dedicated Pal per job rather than spreading cheap Pals across several tasks — a level 7 specialist finishes in a fraction of the time, and a hungry Pal stops working entirely. These pages list the top options for each of the 12 work skills, including the best pick you can realistically catch early on.
